# TextEditBench evaluation source attribution

These four files are copied byte-for-byte from the local checkout of the upstream TextEditBench project:
https://github.com/CSU-JPG/TextEditBench

Research attribution: Rui Gui, Yang Wan, Haochen Han, Dongxing Mao, Fangming Liu, Min Li, and Alex Jinpeng Wang, *TextEditBench: Evaluating Reasoning-aware Text Editing Beyond Rendering*, arXiv:2512.16270.

Original source headers and notices remain in the copied files. See SOURCE_MANIFEST.json for the upstream commit, byte counts, SHA-256 checksums, and the credential-scan result. No upstream evaluation module is executed to read semantic prompts; the benchmark keeps its separately snapshotted prompt text.

The inspected upstream checkout contains no standalone LICENSE, COPYING, or NOTICE file. Do not mistake this notice for an upstream license grant. The source-specific license declarations are retained verbatim in their files. See LICENSE.upstream-status.txt for that provenance limitation.
